styles: children's song to the traditional French nursery tune Frere Jacques (the same melody as 'Are you sleeping, Brother John'), sung exactly on that melody
a warm, smiling young female singer with a small group of happy kids singing along, joyful and expressive, clear English diction
bright xylophone, glockenspiel and pizzicato strings, light shaker, 120 BPM, C major, bouncy preschool cartoon feel

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Two little friends, two little friends,
Run so fast, run so fast!
One has got no ears, one has got no tail.

sections.name: Verse 2
sections.direction: start soft like a whisper, then get louder and louder, ding dang dong very loud and happy at the end
lines: Are you sleeping, are you sleeping,
Morning bells are ringing, morning bells are ringing,
Ding, dang, dong! Ding, dang, dong!

sections.name: Verse 3
sections.direction: big happy cheer, everyone singing together
lines: Now we've got our ears, now we've got our tail.
